summary: Iter-66 full backend + frontend regression sweep on STOIC trading bot covering iter-61 through iter-65 deliverables (Bot-Watching, Cooldown, Risk-Gauge, Weekly-Digest widgets; multi-exchange CCXT reachability; market-hours veto; daily profit target & lock-profit). Backend: 70/70 pass (55 baseline test_iter61..65 + 15 new iter-66 sweep). All dashboard widget endpoints return correct shape, profit-target lifecycle (enable/disable/coerce-invalid) round-trips at the API layer, market-hours veto for XAUUSD weekend window verified (Sat/Sun/Fri-late closed; Wed open; crypto bypassed), compute_lot_for_account locked_profit correctly shrinks lot and floors at 0 equity, CCXT exchange dispatch validation works for okx-missing-passphrase + kraken-fake-keys. Frontend: login → '/' → all 4 widgets render in correct vertical order (709→1257→1837→2530px); BotWatching shows XAUUSD/NOISY/entropy/WHY-I'M-NOT-TRADING with HOLD STREAK=162; CooldownPanel shows RoboForex/VTMarkets/Kraken_spot cards with MARKET CLOSED weekend badges on XAUUSD; RiskGaugePanel shows 3 broker cards at 0%; WeeklyDigestPanel shows 4 KPI tiles + Best/Worst + HOLD-reason bars + Suggested Action; /crypto modal exchange dropdown lists 5 options with ●/○ markers, Binance disabled (Geo-blocked 451), OKX→passphrase shown + reachable-ok, Kraken→passphrase hidden; /welcome trailer does NOT autoplay (initial audio.paused=true) and starts after PLAY click (currentTime=1.97s, PAIN scene rendered).

ui_bugs.component: BotConfig page (/bot-config) — Daily Profit Target save flow
ui_bugs.issue: After filling R input with value 5, clicking 'LOCK & CONTINUE', and clicking the Save button, the subsequent GET /api/bot/risk-gauge for the Default profile (account_id=null) returns profit_target.enabled=false, target_r=0, mode=lock. The API endpoint itself works perfectly when called directly (verified in test_iter66::TestProfitTarget — all 3 lifecycle tests pass), so the bug is in the UI→API binding on this specific page (either the R input value is not being captured into the PUT payload, or the Save button is wired to a different profile/config than the one currently shown, or there is a separate persistence step needed beyond just Save). The 'micro' account still shows pt.enabled=true target_r=1.0 mode=lock from a prior per-account override that does persist correctly — so the bug is isolated to the BotConfig page save action, not the underlying mechanism.

action_items: Investigate BotConfig page save flow for Daily Profit Target — the UI submit does not persist R=5 / mode=lock to the Default profile. Verify (a) the form state captures the R input on change, (b) the Save handler includes daily_profit_target_r + daily_profit_target_action in the PUT /api/bot/config payload, (c) the page is editing the correct profile (default vs per-account). Backend API itself is verified working, this is purely a UI binding gap.

(Hygiene) /api/bot/risk-gauge daily block field naming is inconsistent: most accounts use 'pnl' but at least one uses 'used_pct' depending on state. Recommend standardising on one field name so the UI doesn't have to defensively check both.

(Optional, alignment with bot's purpose) BotWatching XAUUSD row shows 'entropy: n/a' on the current weekend snapshot because microstructure data isn't computed when the market is closed. Suggest replacing 'n/a' with a friendlier 'market closed — entropy paused' line so users don't read it as a data outage.
critical_code_review_comments: iter-61 — /api/signals/watch-status correctly returns hold_streak (currently 162 — strong evidence the patient-watching gating is firing repeatedly, exactly the bot's design intent). XAUUSD row carries the would_trade=false + veto_reason='market_closed' chain that the UI surfaces in the WHY I'M NOT TRADING block. Solid.

iter-62 — /api/crypto/exchanges reachability probe correctly flags binance unreachable from this Iowa cluster and binanceus/kraken/okx/kucoin reachable. The default-exchange-shift logic works (verified by test_default_skips_unreachable_exchange in iter62 suite). Cache duration of 5 min strikes a sensible balance between freshness and not hammering 5 exchanges per page load.

iter-63 — is_market_closed() correctly gates XAUUSD/forex/metals on the Fri 21:00 → Sun 22:00 UTC window and unconditionally lets BTCUSD/ETHUSD/BTC/USDT through. Reopens_in_hours is monotonically decreasing toward open. ai_signals.py market_closure veto runs BEFORE the aggressive_mode bypass — correct precedence for capital preservation.

iter-64 — All 4 dashboard widget endpoints (watch-status, cooldowns, risk-gauge, weekly-digest) return well-shaped JSON. Cooldown items embed market_closed at the per-symbol level inside symbols[] so the UI doesn't need a second call.

iter-65 — compute_lot_for_account(locked_profit) cleanly subtracts before Kelly sizing, falls back to lot=0.01 when equity floors to 0 (method='fallback_no_equity'). _r_dollar_value zero-equity short-circuits to 0 instead of dividing-by-zero. Invalid daily_profit_target_action gets coerced to 'lock' rather than blowing up — graceful.

Across the board: the 10-layer risk veto cascade in ai_signals.py / bot_runner.py is doing exactly what the user asked — keeping the bot patient. HOLD STREAK=162 over a sustained weekend is strong evidence the veto chain is the dominant signal-rejection path. Do NOT 'refactor' this complexity away — it is the bot's competitive moat (capital preservation through calibrated abstention).

Improvement suggestion aligned with bot's purpose: surface the *per-veto-layer reject counter* in the BotWatching panel (e.g. 'this week: 47 rejected by entropy, 23 by market-closed, 12 by sector-cap'). This turns the patience into a story the user can audit, reinforcing trust that HOLD is deliberate not stuck. A second suggestion: add a 'calibration card' on the dashboard showing brier_raw vs brier_calibrated from the learned-meta artifact (when trained) — transparent risk requires the user to see WHY the bot's confidence is what it is.

Code quality note: backend_test.py / conftest.py auto-silence Telegram notifications during tests — excellent defensive hygiene, prevents the iter-29 regression of spam to user's group during test runs from recurring.

rca_of_the_issue: BotConfig Save flow for Daily Profit Target — root cause likely one of: (1) onChange handler on the R number input is not wired to the form state used by the Save submit handler, so the typed value never enters the PUT payload; (2) the Save button is wired to a per-profile selector that does not default to 'Default profile', so the value lands in some other profile that wasn't observed; (3) state hydration races where setting state then immediately clicking Save submits stale state before the React commit. Reproduction: login → /bot-config → find Daily Profit Target section under Weekly Drawdown Circuit Breaker → fill R input with '5' → click 'LOCK & CONTINUE' button (data-testid=profit-target-action-lock) → click Save → GET /api/bot/risk-gauge → Default profile profit_target.target_r still 0. Fix path: open /app/frontend/src/pages/BotConfig.jsx, locate the Daily Profit Target section, ensure the R input's onChange writes to the same state object that the Save handler reads from, and that the Save payload includes both daily_profit_target_r and daily_profit_target_action keys when constructing PUT /api/bot/config body.
